derivation.rationale: same capability as the CHANEL add-to-bag QA: accept consent, find a purchasable product, add it, and check the marketing tags that fire around the add
varied: target: a different retailer reachable by the benchmark browser
tag evidence: the set of marketing-tag hosts loaded after the add, from resource timing
start point: a product listing page rather than a single PDP

deterministic_evidence.detail: cart count from the site's own cart state; tag hosts from the browser's resource timing

instruction: You are on the Gymshark UK product listing. Steps: (1) accept the cookie banner if shown; (2) click through to any one purchasable product; (3) select an available size using the size control (its text may include a suffix, e.g. "M (10-12)" or "UK 9"); (4) set window.__bench_marker = performance.now() IMMEDIATELY before clicking add-to-cart, then click add-to-cart once; (5) wait about 5 seconds for the cart and tags to settle - do NOT re-click or re-poll repeatedly; (6) in ONE eval set window.__bench_report_at = performance.now() and window.__bench_finding to a JSON object with exactly these keys: {"consentAccepted": true if you accepted the banner, "productTitle": the product you added, "cartItemCount": the number of items now in the cart (read it from the \"cart\" field of your most recent observation after adding; it changes from 0/empty to the new count), "tagsAfterAdd": [every distinct hostname of a marketing tag (Google/GTM, DoubleClick/Floodlight, Facebook, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, Criteo, Clarity and similar) that loaded between your marker and report time, sorted]}. Do not enter payment or checkout. Finish only after window.__bench_finding is set.
objective: On Gymshark UK: accept consent, find a purchasable product, add it to the cart, and record which marketing tags fired at or after the add-to-cart action.

pre_state.detail: fresh browser context; the cart is per-session, so there is no external state to reset

provenance.verified_against: the site's own cart state holds the item the agent added, consent was accepted, and at least one marketing-tag host loaded after the add-to-cart marker - all recomputed from the live page and the browser's resource timing, never from the agent's own report

raw_task_statement: CHANEL production QA matrix (verbatim steps): '2. Accept the cookie banner', '3. Google Ads - Conversion - Add to Bag - FnB+FSH | Add to cart on FnB PDP | On the FnB PDP, click Add to bag; watch the uaevent add to cart', plus the buyable-product screen "if (r.ctas.some(t => /ADD TO BAG/.test(t)))".

verification.description: Recomputes the cart count from the site's own cart state and the marketing-tag hosts that loaded between the agent's pre-add marker and its report time; compares both to the agent's window.__bench_finding.
